## Plan document present and linked

Pass. The required implementation plan exists at [cdc840ad-plan.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:1), is substantive, and is linked as the planning issue’s design document.

## Completeness against criteria

Pass. The criterion matrix addresses all nine hard container requirements without narrowing scope ([§1, lines 5–17](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:5)). The design further specifies capture closure, transactional repair, ownership preservation, stable public contracts, and direct predecessor deletion.

## Technical soundness and architectural fit

Pass. The proposed `declarations → repository_state → validation` direction respects the repository’s layer boundaries ([§2, lines 21–22](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:21)).

Its premises match the live code:

- Competing repository models exist in [validation/repository.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:114) and [profile/snapshot.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/profile/snapshot.rs:7).
- Profile planning omits coupled default materializations in [profile/planner.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/profile/planner.rs:155).
- Config publication precedes separate schema and rule-membership writes in [commands/config.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/config.rs:253).
- Project rendering publishes targets individually in [commands/project.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/project.rs:109).
- The current transaction vocabulary lacks deletion and planner preimages in [transaction_action.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/transaction_action.rs:7).
- Recovery is currently a startup boundary that infers the repository from the data-root parent in [recovery_coordinator.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/recovery_coordinator.rs:48).

The plan supplies concrete replacements and deletion inventories for each defect ([§2, lines 23–61](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:23)).

## Decomposition and dependencies

Pass. Five ordered cumulative packages establish foundations before consumer migration, followed by one accountable integration leaf and one assurance leaf ([§3, lines 63–130](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:63)). Tasks have explicit outcomes, acceptance criteria, blast radii, and a transitively reduced dependency chain.

The current revision correctly makes assurance depend on `Integrate repository-state cutover` ([line 111](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:111)), consistent with the sibling-story graph described at line 130.

## Risks and actionability

Pass. Material risks—including root aliases, capture races, recovery ordering, event identity, backend divergence, deletion safety, mixed-authority rules, claim synchronization, and compatibility drift—have explicit decisions and testable mitigations ([§4, lines 132–172](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:132)). No load-bearing question remains unresolved.

## Prior review feedback

Pass. The most recent recorded run passed with no findings. The plan also explicitly resolves the earlier F1–F4 concerns, including scope reduction and executable staging granularity ([lines 136–141](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md:136)).
